decisions.reason: This navigation and observation camera is close to the core space-optics offer and still has a page of its own, so its results likely meet aspirations in a growing industry and give no reason for problemistic search.
The modular multi-model navigation camera line fits the strategy of flexible, compact sensors, and slack from growth lets the firm carry it through long space procurement cycles.

The miniaturized LiDAR is only mentioned on the website, so its market results are still uncertain, but it builds on the firm's docking heritage and its push toward small satellites, and slack allows continued investment.
The newly launched radiation-hard camera line has a page of its own and sits close to the core offer, so it is far too early for a shortfall against aspirations to trigger withdrawal.

The asteroid navigation camera is tied to long-term exploration missions and is only mentioned on the website, but it was launched recently and slack lets the firm carry it while mission results remain uncertain.
